records.summary: Appended Binance's official incident update #2, Reuters corroboration of the company statement, CoinDesk's Ethereum-only PoR analysis, provider-scoped XRP spot/depth/derivatives snapshots, settled and provisional ETF-flow methodology, and Ripple's direct Coinbase RLUSD integration announcement. The Binance company backstop is $6.34B with $5B in exact impacted token assets and approximately $3B reported frozen; token-level XRP replenishment is unknown. CoinDesk's Binance 14 PoR finding is Ethereum-only and does not establish that any of the five XRPL source wallets is in Binance's official XRP PoR set. CoinGecko and TradRadar OI totals are non-comparable universes. XRP ETF 30 October row remains provisional. Coinbase RLUSD collateral on Global Exchange is announced as future availability, not live. No market feature admitted and no forecast issued.
actions: Retrieved Binance Security Incident Update #2 and Reuters' same-day report; recorded the distinction between company funding, exact token assets, remaining market/OTC acquisition and frozen assets.
Cross-checked CoinDesk's October 1 PoR wallet analysis and explicitly confined it to the Ethereum Binance 14 wallet; the five XRPL source-wallet official-PoR crosswalk remains unresolved.
Captured CoinGecko and CoinMarketCap spot aggregates and CoinGecko venue-level order-book depth without treating depth as executable liquidity.
Preserved CoinGecko's broad derivatives universe, TradRadar's seven-exchange aggregate and Seandra's Binance-only panel as separate time- and coverage-scoped series.
Cross-checked Alpha Finance's five-fund ETF flow panel against XRP Insights' issuer-holdings-derived six-spot-plus-BITW dataset; the 30 October row is provisional and excluded.
Recorded Ripple's direct Coinbase RLUSD integration and separated live Prime/Exchange/Retail trading from future Coinbase Global Exchange collateral functionality.
Audited current main and open PRs; verified PR #1386 exact-head core CI at 348 tests plus 8 subtests and its fail-closed gate, while leaving it draft and unmerged.
blockers: Binance's $5B reserve allocation and approximately $3B freeze are company-reported and not token-level XRP proof-of-reserves reconciliation.
The official Binance October 1 XRP PoR address export has not been retrieved and matched against all five XRPL source wallets and the rs8Z destination.
CoinDesk's Binance 14 PoR evidence is Ethereum-only and cannot be generalized to the XRPL source wallets.
CoinGecko and TradRadar derivatives aggregates cover different contract universes and timestamps; no combined OI estimate is valid.
The 30 October XRP ETF row is provisional at the cutoff and must be re-settled before use.
Coinbase RLUSD collateral on Global Exchange is announced as future availability; actual go-live and any XRP collateral exposure are unknown.
The attacker receiver's latest validated-ledger balance and post-06:43 UTC history remain unrefreshed.
next_actions: Download the official Binance October 1 PoR XRP address export and exact-crosswalk the five XRPL sources; keep Binance 14 Ethereum evidence separate.
Retrieve raw validated XRPL account_info for all five source wallets, rs8Z and the attacker receiver; preserve ledger index and exact cutoff.
Reconcile Binance's November 1 PoR snapshot against October 1 by asset and address; calculate XRP-specific coverage only if source wallet membership is proven.
Capture the first settled XRP Insights 30 October ETF row after its scheduled re-settlement; compare issuer holdings with Alpha and other fund-level sources.
Build a venue-by-venue derivatives panel with contract IDs, OI units, funding intervals, timestamps and provider coverage; never average mismatched universes.
Verify Coinbase Global Exchange RLUSD collateral activation from product documentation or live supported functionality; do not infer XRP collateral.
Continue immutable fixed-horizon forecast/outcome design and baseline evaluation; do not issue a forecast before walk-forward and calibration tests.
